items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: I think I probably heard him once or twice, but it's very vague.

ctx.x: I think I probably heard him once or twice, but it's very vague.

He was supposed to be a sensational player, an eccentric player, too, as they call it, doing all those stunts, lying down. What about Merritt Brunus? He's still living and playing over in Biloxi. I don't know.
He was at Friars Inn, too.
